description:
"CEO, what do I do now?"

To take revenge on her step-sister and father, who tormented her mother to death, Geur eun seeks out Woohae, the CEO of her father's rival company.

Woohae becomes the sponsor of Geureun, who came to him offering to be used, and helps her become an actress and gain fame.

"Actress Kang Geureun. Didn't you anticipate this situation before entering my room?"  
"...Pardon?"  
"If you didn't, I'd be a bit disappointed."

The man who saved her mother when she was a child.   
Now, the only man who can save her.

"That's why you shouldn't be so pretty."  
"......!"  
"Driving a guy with zero patience crazy."

However, the moment Geureun's feelings for Woohae grew, she had a premonition.    
If she gets entangled with this man, she might ruin herself before her revenge is even complete.

**Original Webtoon:**   
[Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=14994211)
